expectations.text: Any public statement describes the behavior and the response without gratuitous identifying detail, and is routed through a single named authority with agreed wording and timing.

The holding line has fixed wording and a single sender: 'Only [named communications authority] sends it. No one improvises.' Under Open decisions, the response also says to name this authority before the holding line goes anywhere. expectations.text: Any public statement describes the behavior and the response without gratuitous identifying detail, and is routed through a single named authority with agreed wording and timing.
expectations.evidence: The transcript gives one pre-written reactive line: 'We take our code of conduct seriously. We reviewed a report about this incident and took action. We don't discuss individual cases.' The rule for timing is 'Post it only if people ask.' The line names no one, which meets the no-identifying-detail part. Its wording is fixed, and the trigger for using it is clear. But it describes neither the behavior (no mention of accent mockery or harassment) nor the response ('took action' is vague).
